actions: Scheduled new cycle-6 goal set (5 goals) in memory/goals/mechanic.md - focus: hot LLM loading expansion + functional verification
Goal 2 BUILT: Added `verify` subcommand to hotload_controller.py - sends test prompt via /v1/chat/completions, confirms model responds. Tested: correct error handling for unreachable host.

Goal 3 BUILT: Added `swap` subcommand with --dry-run flag. Full 7-step atomic swap (idle gate -> snapshot -> unload src -> load dst -> poll -> verify aliases -> functional probe). Rollback on failure. Risk assessment includes eviction warnings + VRAM check. Tested: dry-run produces correct plan.

Goal 5 BUILT: Added record_load_time() + cmd_report(). Tracks load times in load_trend.jsonl, computes per-model median baseline, alerts if latest > 2x median. Seeded with 7 test data points. Regression detection verified (Q8 520s vs 243s median correctly flagged).
Catalog updated: added alias fields to hotload-catalog.json (qwen3-27b-q8 -> atlas-q8, qwen3-27b-q4 -> quinn-q4)
